content.value: Control charts for X and R is maintained on the outide diameter of a helical spring. The subgroup size is 5. The value of X and R are computed from each sub-group. After the inspection of 25 sub-groups, it was observed that $\Sigma \bar { X } = 5 \dot { 1 } . 5 0$ and $\Sigma R = 0 . 3 7 5$ . The specification for the product is $2 . 0 5 0 \ : \pm \ : 0 . 0 2 0$ . If the dimension falls above the upper specification limit, rework is required; if it falls below the lower specification limit, the product is rejected. If the process is under statistical control and normally distributed, determine the percentages of rework and scrap. Can you make any suggestion to improve the situation? How? Show the improvement numerically.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
